memory_update.text: AROC should remain in the underfollowed lane for gas reliability because contract compression and aftermarket services may be recurring infrastructure exposure rather than pure drilling beta.
KGS is a high-purity compression-infrastructure candidate; next layer should test distributed-power materiality, contract tenor, and leverage.

node: Oil/gas reliability, LNG infrastructure, compression, valves, onsite power, and electrification-adjacent equipment
summary: Expanded the underfollowed lane for the oil/gas reliability and LNG-power infrastructure node. The most relevant public-market map is not pure E&P commodity beta, but installed-base compression, large-horsepower gas infrastructure services, engineered electrical systems for LNG/data-center/utility loads, and PVF distribution gates. Baker Hughes is retained only as a reference leader for LNG turbomachinery and gas-compression context; the underfollowed discovery lane is Archrock, Kodiak Gas Services, Powell Industries, and MRC Global. Key next work is to verify backlog quality, contract duration, fleet utilization, LNG-project concentration, customer concentration, and whether demand is tied to durable reliability/electrification needs rather than short-cycle oil/gas capex.
